-- Read-only snapshot restore check. Only catalog metadata and six aggregate counts.
BEGIN READ ONLY;
SET LOCAL statement_timeout = '10s';
SET LOCAL lock_timeout = '2s';
DO $guard$ BEGIN
IF current_setting('neon.branch_id',true) NOT IN ('br-fragrant-bread-aibgpawc','br-green-union-ailxs0g3')
 OR current_database() <> 'neondb' OR current_setting('transaction_read_only') <> 'on'
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Wrong read-only recovery target'; END IF;
END $guard$;
WITH table_fingerprints AS (
  SELECT c.relname AS name, c.relkind::text AS kind, c.relrowsecurity AS rls, c.relforcerowsecurity AS force_rls,
    (SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_attribute a WHERE a.attrelid=c.oid AND a.attnum>0 AND NOT a.attisdropped) AS columns_count,
    (SELECT md5(coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(a.attname,format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod),a.attnotnull,coalesce(pg_get_expr(d.adbin,d.adrelid),''),a.attidentity,a.attgenerated) ORDER BY a.attname)::text,'[]'))
     FROM pg_attribute a LEFT JOIN pg_attrdef d ON d.adrelid=a.attrelid AND d.adnum=a.attnum
     WHERE a.attrelid=c.oid AND a.attnum>0 AND NOT a.attisdropped) AS columns_hash,
    (SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_constraint k WHERE k.conrelid=c.oid AND k.contype <> 'n') AS constraints_count,
    (SELECT md5(coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(k.conname,k.contype,pg_get_constraintdef(k.oid,true),k.convalidated,k.condeferrable,k.condeferred) ORDER BY k.conname)::text,'[]'))
     FROM pg_constraint k WHERE k.conrelid=c.oid AND k.contype <> 'n') AS constraints_hash,
    (SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_indexes i WHERE i.schemaname='public' AND i.tablename=c.relname) AS indexes_count,
    (SELECT md5(coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(i.indexname,i.indexdef) ORDER BY i.indexname)::text,'[]'))
     FROM pg_indexes i WHERE i.schemaname='public' AND i.tablename=c.relname) AS indexes_hash
  FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace
  WHERE n.nspname='public' AND c.relkind IN ('r','p')
), enum_values AS (
 SELECT t.typname AS name, jsonb_agg(e.enumlabel ORDER BY e.enumsortorder) AS labels
 FROM pg_type t JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=t.typnamespace JOIN pg_enum e ON e.enumtypid=t.oid
 WHERE n.nspname='public' GROUP BY t.typname
)
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
 'database',current_database(),
 'read_only',current_setting('transaction_read_only'),
 'tables',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(f) ORDER BY f.name),'[]'::jsonb) FROM table_fingerprints f),
 'enums',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(e) ORDER BY e.name),'[]'::jsonb) FROM enum_values e),
 'migration_tables',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('schema',n.nspname,'table',c.relname) ORDER BY n.nspname,c.relname),'[]'::jsonb)
  FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE c.relkind IN ('r','p') AND n.nspname NOT IN ('pg_catalog','information_schema')
  AND (c.relname ILIKE '%migration%' OR n.nspname='drizzle'))
) AS carearound_schema_preflight;
SELECT jsonb_build_object('branch',current_setting('neon.branch_id',true),
 'database',current_database(),'read_only',current_setting('transaction_read_only'),
 'users',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.users),
 'hard_assets',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.hard_assets),
 'soft_assets',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.soft_assets),
 'user_favorites',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.user_favorites),
 'my_maps',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.my_maps),
 'my_map_assets',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.my_map_assets)
) AS recovery_counts;
ROLLBACK;
